items.title: Project Hail Mary
items.description: An astronaut wakes up alone in a space capsule with amnesia, and must find a way to save Earth from an extinction-level threat with an unlikely alien ally.

items.title: Eridian Dawn
items.description: Chronicles the discovery of the orbital astrophage organism and the high-hazard scientific mission sent to investigate it.

items.title: Silicon Horizon
items.description: A synthetic detective uncovers a database containing repressed memories of the original human settlers in Neo-Tokyo.

items.title: The Weaver of Astrophage
items.description: The intricate engineering challenges of building a starship powered by relativistic biological fuel cells.

items.title: Outlier Echoes
items.description: A long-range deep-space antenna picks up an anomalous signal originating from inside the Oort Cloud, repeating a prime number sequence.

items.title: Solitude in Space
items.description: A single engineer works maintaining a communications relay station in deep-space dark zones, exploring solitude and human identity.

items.title: The Pine Cabin
items.description: A writer retreats to an isolated forest cabin only to find that she is not alone, as strange signals begin broadcasting from an ancient radio.

items.title: Tau Ceti Transit
items.description: An epic cinematic exploration of the journey from Sol to the Tau Ceti system, spanning thirty years of near-luminal travel and cryogenic stasis.

items.title: Glacial Rift
items.description: An expedition navigating a treacherous ice-shelf rift in search of prehistoric records trapped inside a sub-glacial pocket.
